actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Welcome to the Yard Marshal training module. Today you'll learn how to safely guide trucks in and out of the dock yard.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's start by putting on your gear. Grab each item to wear it - jacket, shoes, cap, whistle, and walkie-talkie.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Don't forget \u2014 touch each item to wear it.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Touch the highlighted item to put it on.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"As a Yard Marshal, you'll communicate and coordinate with your team via walkie-talkie.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You'll coordinate with the Dock Associate to guide trucks to the correct docking bays.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"And you'll use the correct audio and visual cues to guide the driver.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The journey for trucks starts at the main gate where the driver needs to collect the gate pass and a reflective jacket at the yard management system gate and then go to either the parking or docks as per instructions.","waitForCompletion":false,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let us look at what can go wrong if the yard marshal is not following the rules.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Always stand on the Right Hand Side of a moving truck — it keeps you in the driver's clear line of sight. Yard marshal should never stand on the opposite side of the driver or behind the truck while guiding it.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Choose the side you need to stand on to guide the truck.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: MCQResponseAction
actions.Data: {"questionIndex":1,"questionText":"Choose the side you need to stand on to guide the truck.","optionsList":["Right hand side","Left hand side"],"correctOptionIndex":[1],"showAnswerDuration":2.0,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Correct, Right hand side keeps you visible to the driver.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Remember standing on the Left hand side puts you outside the driver's view.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Right hand side keeps you visible to the driver.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick a side to stand on to guide the truck.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"To communicate with your coworker, you need to use a walkie talkie. Go ahead and grab the walkie-talkie.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"This is the dock associate speaking, truck with number plate ending in three five nine one needs to be parked in dock bay 2.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Remember for vehicle placement, the Yard Marshal will receive communication from the dock team over the walkie-talkie regarding where the vehicle needs to be docked.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the whistle to guide the truck driver forward, until they reach bay 2.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Always ensure that the truck does not exceed the 15-kilometer-per-hour speed limit inside the yard and a 8 kilometer per hour limit in the parking area.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Watch closely this is the correct way to reverse-park a truck. Stand on the RHS, in the driver's clear line of sight. Use short, sharp whistle blasts to signal keep moving, paired with a steady hand motion pointing the direction to turn.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"It is your time to signal the truck to stop. Grab the whistle and blow a long, continuous whistle.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Blow the whistle to stop the truck.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Use the whistle now to stop the truck before it is too late.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"It is your responsibility to collect the yard pass and vehicle documents from the driver. Grab the documents from their hand.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Take the document from the driver.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Grab the documents from the driver now.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The driver needs to step out of the vehicle. What is the correct procedure they should follow?","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: MCQResponseAction
actions.Data: {"questionIndex":2,"questionText":"What should the driver do before stepping out?","optionsList":["Apply hand brake, turn off vehicle, then step out","Leave engine running and step out"],"correctOptionIndex":[1],"showAnswerDuration":2.0,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Not quite, leaving the engine running is unsafe.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Always ask the driver to turn off their vehicle and apply hand break before stepping out.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Take the keys from the driver.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The keys need to be handed over to the dock associate.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The dock associate performs seal cutting process. Once it is done, the truck needs to move forward. I've handed the truck keys back to the driver for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Grab the whistle to blow short but continous whistles to indicate the driver to move.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Use the whistle to guide the truck forward.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The driver needs to turn off the vehicle and get down to open the truck's back doors.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Time to reverse the truck back into the bay. Grab the whistle to start guiding the driver into position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Use the whistle to guide the truck in reverse.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Once the driver exits the vehicle safely and has submitted the truck keys, they need to be escorted to the driver's restroom until it is time for them to leave.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You need to apply wheel chocks to the parked truck. Grab and place a wheel chock to the tyre.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Place a chock at the marked tire.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The second wheel chock needs to be placed on the diagonally opposite tyre. Let me do it for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

moments.name: Place Safety Cone at Dock Entry

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Next, you need to place a safety cone at the dock entry. Grab the safety cone and place it in position.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Place the safety cone at the marked spot.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let me place a cone on each side of the truck for you.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"During rainy days, you need to wear the monsoon-specific PPE. These include reflective raincoat, gum boots, an umbrella, a whistle, and a traffic baton. Go ahead and grab them from the table.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Pick up all the PPE items you need during monsoon.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Remember at night, you'll always need to use a light baton to guide truck drivers.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The light signals made with a traffic baton mean different things. Take a look.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"A solid green light means go, or proceed forward.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Which light signal should you use to signal the truck to move?.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: MCQResponseAction
actions.Data: {"questionIndex":3,"questionText":"Which light should you use to signal the truck to move?","optionsList":["Solid Green","Solid Red","Blinking Red"],"correctOptionIndex":[1],"showAnswerDuration":2.0,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Not quite, that signal doesn't tell the driver to move.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text": "Select the light that signals the truck to move.", "waitForCompletion": true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let us look at what happens if safety protocol while exiting the dock is not followed.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"The truck driver was handed the key before the back door could be locked. When the truck started moving, the items inside fell out and struck the yard marshal.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Never hand the keys back to the driver before thoroughly checking that the loading or unloading is complete and the vehicle is safe to leave the dock.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"If there is a visitor at the dock, you are in-charge of their safety and visit. Always ensure that you provide them with the necessary P P E and educate them about using only the pedestrian walkway and crossings at all times.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"You need to give the visitors a valid yard pass for their entry. Grab the yard pass from the table and hand it over to the visitor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Take the yard pass from the table and give it to the visitor.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Hand the yard pass to the visitor now.","waitForCompletion":true}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Remember that the visitors always follow your instructions as a yard marshal.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Let's review what you've learned. Grab each card, read it, and drop it in the correct bin — green for Do's, red for Don'ts.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}

actions.Name: VoiceOver
actions.Data: {"text":"Great job! You have learnt about the roles, responsibilities and operations of a yard marshal. You have completed the module.","waitForCompletion":true,"targetRoleSetId":0}
